name: Mama tte Yonde mo Ii no ka na? ~Watashi ga Aka-chan ni Naru made~
original_name: ママって呼んでもいいのかな？ ～私が赤ちゃんになるまで～
source:
Ichika, a young girl in the pharmacy department of a university, was busy balancing her daily studies with a part-time job to earn money for university fees.
She was in danger of one day having to stay in university.

Then she hears a story about a friend of hers who made a lot of money with a secret part-time job.

Ichika's family is a single parent and she has younger siblings, so if she were to stay in university, it would cause problems for her family...with this in mind, she accesses a website where secret part-time jobs are listed.

On the website, she sees an offer from a woman for "500,000 yen for two weeks of play," and decides that if the play partner is a woman...she will take her up on the offer.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/announce/=/product_id/RJ395300.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
Ichika在大学药学部上课，同时还得兼职攒学费，每天忙得不可开交。她甚至可能哪天就得辍学。

后来，她听说一位朋友靠着一份秘密兼职赚了不少钱。

Ichika家是单亲家庭，还有年幼的弟妹；要是她没法继续读大学，家里就会陷入困境……考虑到这些，她打开了一个刊登秘密兼职信息的网站。

她看到一名女性开出“两周扮演的报酬是50万日元”的委托，心想，如果对象是女性……那她愿意接受。
